provenance.note: Generic layout from the standard Fan service (on at piid 1, fan-level at piid 2); the wire fan-level is a 4-step value the driver translates to 25/50/75/100 percent. Oscillation and timer services vary by model and are not claimed here.

source: MIoT-Spec standard Fan service definition for the fan device type, as published in the MIoT specification (miot-spec.org): the device's main service is siid 2.
